Private address state variable tracking the current game/question owner.
Bytes32 state variable holding keccak256 hash of the expected response.
External payable function that checks the response hash and msg.value, then transfers the contract balance to msg.sender.

Public payable function that lets questionSender drain the contract balance.

edges.reason: Try uses the caller-supplied msg.sender in the msg.sender == tx.origin authentication check.
Try compares msg.sender against the attacker-influenced tx.origin, a tx.origin dependency.
Try reads responseHash to validate the submitted response.
When the response matches and msg.value > 3 ether, Try executes the external balance transfer.
The transfer recipient is the caller-controlled msg.sender, enabling callback into the contract.
set_game writes keccak256(_response) into responseHash.
set_game writes _question into the question state variable.
set_game assigns msg.sender into questionSender.
StopGame authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with questionSender.
StopGame performs an external balance transfer after the ownership check.
The transfer recipient in StopGame is the caller-controlled msg.sender, enabling callback into the contract.
NewQuestion overwrites the question state variable.
NewQuestion overwrites responseHash with the supplied hash.
newQuestioner gates the ownership update on msg.sender == questionSender.
Try consumes the _response parameter in the keccak256 comparison.
set_game consumes the _question parameter.
set_game consumes the _response parameter for hashing.
NewQuestion consumes the _question parameter.
NewQuestion consumes the _responseHash parameter.
newQuestioner consumes the newAddress parameter.
The newAddress parameter is written into questionSender, transferring game ownership.
keccak256 of the _response parameter is compared with the responseHash state variable.
